audit_items.proof_trace: The protocol uses Pyth oracle exclusively — an external off-chain price feed aggregated by Pyth validators. Flash loans are on-chain operations and cannot affect Pyth's off-chain price attestations, making in-transaction price manipulation structurally impossible. Borrow/collateral health checks use `get_price_with_check` (returns EMA), and the only `get_spot_price` call (in liquidation seize calculation) reads Pyth's aggregated spot, not any AMM pool price — no AMM-based oracle path exists in the codebase.
